q1_issues.issue: The definite plural "the admirers" is dropped entirely — no group witness (GroupOf sk_group_1 admirer) and no PartOf links for the named members — so membership in a specific presupposed set is flattened into plain typing of each individual.

The Name string "Antonio Benavente" is not this mention's surface capitalized run (the text has only "Antonio" before the shared surname), against "string literals preserve surface form" and "the name is exactly its capitalized run of words".

coordinated surname ellipsis ("Antonio and Jacinto Benavente") — nothing says whether the first conjunct's symbol and Name string inherit the shared surname

an appositive that asserts a symmetric kinship relation over the coordinated names ("the brothers Antonio and Jacinto") — the appositive-tense rule enumerates only Member / Inheritance / PartOf, so whether such a relation atom takes the past host's wrapper is unstated
notes: Brother + (Symmetric Brother) is the licensed open-class symmetric relation, and the distributive replication of the past-wrapped copular atom over the three named individuals is correct.
